نستورط (form X)
# نَسْتَوْرِطُ (nastawriṭu) /nas.taw.ri.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْرَطَ (istawraṭa)
# نَسْتَوْرِطَ (nastawriṭa) /nas.taw.ri.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْرَطَ (istawraṭa)
# نَسْتَوْرِطْ (nastawriṭ) /nas.taw.ritˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَوْرَطَ (istawraṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
